svg.title: Storage variants with one and eight senders
svg.desc: Simplified BoxedDebounce; medians and observed minimum–maximum across nine interleaved rounds, not confidence intervals. Separate zero-based scales. Single-sender medians: 13.2, 13.1, 13.2, 13.1, 17.9 ns; eight-sender medians: 86.8, 79.7, 54.2, 84.6, 65.7 ns. Order: Mutex, adjacent, padded, OSAllocated, separate.
